images.label: 瞄具
images.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE category icon for a dark black/gray gunsmith interface, the master style reference for a nine-icon matching family. Subject: a clearly recognizable compact holographic gun sight with its protective rectangular hood, dark lens opening, and short mounting foot; not a whole firearm. Design it as a substantial 2.5D machined-metal relief pictogram, broad readable forms that still work at 32 and 48 screen pixels, rather than a detailed catalog photo. Orthographic view with a small consistent 12 degree yaw and 8 degree downward viewing angle. Materials: satin brushed silver-gray front faces, darker graphite recessed areas, fine bright chamfer along silhouette, moderate roughness, realistic subdued metal shading. Neutral grayscale only, soft key light from upper left, very soft short contact shadow. Entire icon centered in a SQUARE canvas, fills about 68 percent in each relevant dimension, generous uniform safe margin. Background must be perfectly uniform solid #181818 across the entire square. The icon is the object itself: no backing tile, no badge, no enclosing circle or square, no frame. No blue tint, colored lenses, neon, bloom, emissive glow, rust, dirt, heavy scratches, excessive screws, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, watermarks or extra objects. Crisp clean silhouette. This is a navigation icon style proposal; do not show mechanical diagrams or assembly instructions.
images.visualReview: 矩形镜罩、暗镜片与底座可辨；银灰主面和石墨内层形成清晰明暗。
